name: agent-skills
description: The secure, validated skill registry for professional AI coding agents. Extend Antigravity, Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot and more with absolute confidence.
one_liner: A vetted, security-checked library of 'skills' — pre-built instructions and abilities — that you can plug into AI coding assistants like Claude Code or Cursor to give them new capabilities safely.
buyer: An engineering lead at a company standardizing which AI-coding-agent add-ons their developers are allowed to install.
business_use_cases: An enterprise runs a private, audited internal skill registry so developers can't install unvetted AI-agent extensions.
A dev tools company builds a paid marketplace layer on top, taking a cut of premium skill sales.
A security consultancy offers 'AI agent supply-chain audits' for companies worried about malicious skills.

money_ideas.idea: Sell a private, compliance-audited registry subscription to enterprises deploying AI coding agents at scale.
Take a marketplace commission on paid premium skills sold through a hosted storefront.

steal_this: A dev-tool ecosystem play, not a standalone weekend product — the real opportunity is an enterprise security/compliance layer on top, which needs real security expertise to do credibly.
